intro: End long days your way with TuneIn. Sink into plush seats, recline at the touch of a button, ease back stress, and charge your phone while you relax. Your comfort, your control, without ever leaving the couch.

features.title: Recline your way, every day
features.text: Motorized recline, headrest, and lumbar support adjust independently, so you find your perfect angle whether reading, napping, or binge-watching.

features.title: Charge without moving a muscle
features.text: Built-in USB-A and Type-C ports keep your devices powered, so you never interrupt your comfort just to hunt for a charging point.

features.title: Style that feels like home
features.text: A dual-tone blend of mushroom fabric and peanut leatherette creates a modern yet inviting look that suits both cozy nooks and urban apartments.

features.title: Melt away stress
features.text: Elevate your feet to relieve back tension and reduce spinal strain, a soothing posture that makes everyday relaxation effortless.

features.title: Compact design, full comfort
features.text: Generously cushioned yet space-conscious, this 2-seater delivers big comfort in smaller living spaces, perfect for flats or snug corners.

features.title: Upholstery built to last
features.text: High-performance fabric resists wear and tear while staying soft to the touch, making upkeep simple and comfort long-lasting.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Tunein Motorised 2-Seater Fabric Recliner With Usb Port
